# Asset Inventory: the art and audio that replace the placeholders

**Feature**: [spec 002](spec.md) (User Story 4, FR-029, FR-030, SC-003) | **Reference**: [design board](ux-design-board.webp)

<!-- Generated by `dotnet run --project playtest/preview -- --inventory` from
     client/Assets/Bloomlings/UI/Design/AssetSlots.cs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every visual and sound the game now draws or plays as a placeholder has a slot here. Every slot is drawn or played
somewhere in the game, or it is marked "not in the game yet". The id is the placeholder's name in code, so each final
asset replaces exactly one placeholder.

How to read the columns:

- **Frames** are the numbers on the design board.
- **Size**:
  - Icon: up to 96 px;
  - Small: up to 192 px;
  - Medium: up to 512 px;
  - Large: up to 1024 px;
  - Screen: full screen, portrait, from 16:9 to 21:9.
- **Readable**: the asset must stay readable at small sizes and pass the readability checks of spec 001:
  grayscale and icon, small size, color distance, and the pod, slot and moving-character tests.
- **Priority**: Launch means needed for launch; Later means it can follow.
